Get Involved [...] # Statement From NVIDIA Board of Directors

November 8, 2026

  Statement From NVIDIA Board of Directors  

The NVIDIA Board is initiating an independent investigation in light of recent reporting that founder and CEO Jensen Huang has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort.

A committee of independent directors, assisted by outside independent counsel, will oversee the investigation.

items.title: Nvidia stock falls amid probe into CEO’s relationship with Chinese spy
items.summary:
“A committee of independent directors, assisted by outside independent counsel, will oversee the investigation,” Nvidia said in a Sunday statement. “The Board prioritizes U.S. national and economic security, which is paramount to the interests of NVIDIA and its shareholders.”

An Nvidia spokesperson told NBC News that Huang was “committed to continuing to lead NVIDIA as CEO without interruption.” [...] Jensen Huang has become one of the main forces driving the global AI push while steering Nvidia to a market value of more than $4 trillion. Huang has led Nvidia since he founded it in 1993, so it would be a seismic change if he were to leave the role. [...] Nvidia’s peers, such as AMD, Qualcomm, Taiwan Semi and Intel, all rose along with the broader market. Nvidia was the biggest loser on the Dow, the Nasdaq 100 and S&P 500.

With so many outstanding questions about the Huang scandal, few major analysts that cover Nvidia had weighed in on Monday morning about what it could mean for the company’s future.

But those who did said it was a blemish on an otherwise sterling track record, which could spark even more investigations.

items.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admits affair, board to launch investigation
items.summary:
The woman, Alice Huang, was recruited to seek information and potentially push for Nvidia's advanced chips to be made available in China, countering existing restrictions, the Times reported. 

What they're saying:"Today's news will not slow NVIDIA. Jensen is committed to continuing to lead NVIDIA as CEO without interruption," John Rizzo, head of public policy communications at Nvidia said in a statement. [...] "I was unfaithful to my wife. My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did."
   Huang said he took "full responsibility" for his actions, adding that he had fallen short of his responsibilities to Nvidia's employees, board and shareholders.
   "Leading NVIDIA is the privilege of my life," Huang wrote. "I am fully committed to NVIDIA and will work to earn back your confidence." [...] Driving the news: "I owe my family and all of you an apology," Huang wrote in a draft email to Nvidia employees obtained by Axios.

items.title: Nvidia launches investigation into CEO’s alleged relationship with Chinese spy : NPR
items.summary:
In the statement announcing the investigation, Nvidia cited recent reporting by The New York Times, which alleges Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was the target of a Chinese intelligence operation that sought to send advanced Nvidia AI chips to China.

"While the Board has no reason to believe that either national security or NVIDIA secrets were compromised, the Board's inquiry will examine all available information," the statement from the company's board of directors reads in part. [...] Nvidia dominates the global market for AI chips, and has seen explosive growth in recent years, as NPR has reported. The company started as a manufacturer of chips for computer graphics, which later turned out to be crucial for training artificial intelligence.

Nvidia's CEO and President Trump have repeatedly appeared in public together in recent years. According to Huang, Nvidia is helping to fund the construction of a new ballroom at the White House.

items.title: IANA-managed Reserved Domains
items.summary:
# IANA-managed Reserved Domains

Certain domains are set aside, and nominally registered to “IANA”, for specific
policy or technical purposes.

## Example domains

As described in [RFC 2606](https://www.iana.org/go/rfc2606) and [RFC 6761](https://www.iana.org/go/rfc6761),
a number of domains such as example.com and example.org
are maintained for documentation purposes. These domains may be used as illustrative
examples in documents without prior coordination with us. They are
not available for registration or transfer.

## Test IDN top-level domains

These domains were temporarily delegated by IANA for the [IDN Evaluation](http://www.icann.org/topics/idn/) being conducted by [ICANN](http://www.icann.org/).

| Domain | Domain (A-label) | Language | Script |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| إختبار | xn--kgbechtv | Arabic | Arabic |
| آزمایشی | xn--hgbk6aj7f53bba | Persian | Arabic |
| 测试 | xn--0zwm56d | Chinese | Han (Simplified variant) |
| 測試 | xn--g6w251d | Chinese | Han (Traditional variant) |
| испытание | xn--80akhbyknj4f | Russian | Cyrillic |
| परीक्षा | xn--11b5bs3a9aj6g | Hindi | Devanagari (Nagari) |
| δοκιμή | xn--jxalpdlp | Greek, Modern (1453-) | Greek |
| 테스트 | xn--9t4b11yi5a | Korean | Hangul (Hangŭl, Hangeul) |
| טעסט | xn--deba0ad | Yiddish | Hebrew |
| テスト | xn--zckzah | Japanese | Katakana |
| பரிட்சை | xn--hlcj6aya9esc7a | Tamil | Tamil |

## Policy-reserved domains

We act as both the registrant and registrar for a select number of domains
which have been reserved under policy grounds. These exclusions are
typically indicated in either technical standards (RFC documents),
or [contractual limitations](http://www.icann.org/en/registries/agreements.htm).

Domains which are described as registered to IANA or ICANN on policy
grounds are not available for registration or transfer, with the exception
of _country-name_.info domains. These domains are available for release
by the ICANN Governmental Advisory Committee Secretariat.

## Other Special-Use Domains

There is additionally a [Special-Use Domain Names](https://www.iana.org/assignments/special-use-domain-names) registry documenting special-use domains designated by technical standards. For further information, see [Special-Use Domain Names](https://www.iana.org/go/rfc6761) (RFC 6761).
